critical_code_review_comments: MilestoneListener acknowledges after firing the toast — correct order (fire → acknowledge). Uses inFlight ref to prevent concurrent duplicate toasts across mount/focus events.

GET /api/coupons/history JOIN-fallback: when meta.coupon_type is missing, it batch-fetches coupons collection to recover 'auto_daily' vs 'manual' — legacy-safe. Deleted coupons default to 'manual' which is a sensible default.
POST /referrals/rewards/acknowledge uses $addToSet with $each for idempotency — good.
MilestoneListener skips admins (user.role === 'admin') — sensible; prevents unnecessary polls.
canvas-confetti bursts fire correctly; canvas element is inserted into body as expected.
